model_annotation: This chart visualizes the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry – specifically industry, construction, trade, and other services – in 2021, expressed as a percentage of the total economy. The chart consists of three separate pie charts, each with four slices representing the four industry categories. The first pie chart, representing the number of enterprises, includes slices labeled “Industry” (orange, approximately 61%), “Construction” (red, approximately 19%), “Trade” (blue, approximately 12%), and “Other Services” (light blue, approximately 8%). The second pie chart, representing the number of persons employed, shows “Industry” (orange, approximately 51%), “Trade” (blue, approximately 19%), “Construction” (red, approximately 9%), and “Other Services” (light blue, approximately 21%). The third pie chart, representing turnover, displays “Industry” (orange, approximately 33%), “Trade” (blue, approximately 31%), “Construction” (red, approximately 6%), and “Other Services” (light blue, approximately 31%). Each pie chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and a legend at the bottom identifying the color-coding for each industry. The slices within each chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion.
